summary: Iteration 8 (event overlays). 16/16 backend pytest cases pass end-to-end (auth/RBAC, CRUD, shapes with unknown-type filtering, image upload+serve, patch, delete-file, cascade file cleanup, private WS overlay_upserted/overlay_removed, public WS active-only fanout with deactivate->overlay_removed, snapshot active-only, regression on existing endpoints). Frontend Playwright verified admin login, OverlayManagerPanel presence in Ops sidebar, global toggle-overlays label reflects on/off + active count, overlay create->row immediately in editing mode (cyan left border), leaflet-geoman toolbar mounts on the map, per-row toggle-active/edit/rename/delete/upload data-testids all present and functional, chevron expands to reveal upload button, delete removes row after confirm. SituationalView (unauthenticated public token) renders active overlay shapes on the map and situational-toggle-overlays toggles them off/on.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1067 uses a hard-coded absolute path '/app/backend/uploads/overlays' for _UPLOADS_DIR. It matches ROOT_DIR but is not derived from it — if the app is ever relocated the uploads directory drifts from the URL prefix. Consider ROOT_DIR / 'uploads' / 'overlays'. Non-blocking.

server.py overlays_add_image: file.read() loads the full body in memory before size check. If a client uploads a 500 MB file it will consume 500 MB of RAM before the 413 fires. Consider streaming or checking Content-Length first. Non-blocking for internal ops but worth noting.

overlays.py.replace_shapes: shape 'color' is not validated (any string accepted). Pydantic model OverlayShape also accepts arbitrary strings for color. Low priority — geoman-generated colours are trusted.

OverlayManagerPanel expands each overlay via the chevron button which shares a bare <button> without a data-testid; not ideal for automation but the requested overlay-upload-<id> testid inside is reachable after clicking. Minor.

Static mount /api/uploads is intentionally unauthenticated per spec (public snapshot needs to fetch overlay images). Confirmed no other files leak because mount root is /app/backend/uploads and only overlays/ subdir is used.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested dashboard + situational overlay flows verified)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create their own TEST_ prefixed overlay sets, one situational token, and a TEST_ov_user_* account, all cleaned up in fixtures/teardown. Playwright test creates one overlay in the UI and deletes it via the delete button before finishing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration8_overlays.py -o addopts=` (project's pytest.ini enables xdist loadscope which conflicts). Requires websocket-client and requests. Public /api/uploads is a StaticFiles mount with no auth by design. The already-seeded active overlay 'HalloweenRun2026' (with an 'Aid Station 1' marker near lat 40,-105) is left in place — do NOT delete it unless your test recreates it.
